meta.title: Correlation matrix and parlay/player-prop combo pricing
meta.method: Pearson r via NIST formula; p-values via F(1,N-2); 95% CI via Fisher z; phi coefficient for binary cover-vs-over. Same-game legs measured per team-game so both sides included.

rows.pair: QB passing yards vs WR1 receiving yards (same team)
rows.interpretation: Strong positive coupling — same-team pass game drives both legs; independent pricing overstates SGP value by ~95%.

rows.pair: QB passing yards vs WR2 receiving yards
rows.interpretation: Moderate positive; both receivers share QB volume.

rows.pair: WR1 receiving yards vs WR2 receiving yards (same team)
rows.interpretation: Weak positive — shared QB but competing targets; not independent.

rows.pair: RB1 rushing yards vs QB passing yards (same team)
rows.interpretation: Weak negative — run-heavy scripts suppress pass volume (complementarity).

rows.pair: Home points vs away points (pace coupling)
rows.interpretation: Tiny negative — netting out venue, scores move slightly opposite; do not treat as positively coupled.

rows.pair: Winning margin vs game total (score correlation)
rows.interpretation: Essentially independent — margin and total carry different information.

rows.pair: Home cover vs over (binary association, phi)
rows.interpretation: Essentially independent — covering does not meaningfully predict going over.

rows.pair: 4-leg same-team parlay: joint exceedance vs product
rows.interpretation: Empirical joint 11.1% vs independent product 5.7% — pricing legs independently would quote ~16-to-1 against true ~8-to-1.

pricing_note: Same-team legs must be priced with measured correlation (e.g., Gaussian copula calibrated to r=0.562, implied ρ≈0.60). Cross-game legs (different games) are approximately independent (r≈0). Player-prop combos need ex-ante WR assignments (depth-ranked), not ex-post game leaders (which inflate r by +0.24).
